description: Writes the scenes of a `plan_required` niche for the user to read before the paid run (`generate_from_niche` with its `plan_id`). FREE: no go needed. Start with `slug`, `revision`, `values` (and `duration_seconds` if asked); it waits about 20 s; then follow its `next_step`. The flow: `get_recipe` `niche-run`.

duration_seconds.description: One of the niche's `settings.options.durations_seconds`; longer costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

plan_id.description: Reads that preview instead (send it alone).

name: preview_niche_script
title: Write a niche's script (free preview)
